blockHTabScopedViewModes.whatShipped: Greyholm side (src/state/campaignStore.tsx): reviewed a prior session's uncommitted diff (mode already excluded from the shared overlay JSON and from cross-tab IMPORT_OVERLAY) and kept it as correct; added the missing piece -- sessionStorage-backed loadPersistedMode/savePersistedMode so mode survives a reload of the SAME tab instead of hard-resetting to 'dm-view'. Caldran side (src/state/userCampaignStore.tsx, net-new this pass): found and fixed the equivalent real bug -- runtime.mode (dmView/dmEdit/playerView) lived inside UserCampaignRuntime, written to localStorage AND pushed to the server / broadcast to every other subscribed tab via pushBlob + subscribeUc, so toggling Player View in one DM tab would have silently flipped every other open tab (including real players' browsers) into that mode. Fixed with the same sessionStorage-per-tab pattern, keyed per campaignId: loadUcTabMode/saveUcTabMode; readRuntime always overrides the returned mode with the calling tab's own sessionStorage value; patchRuntime strips mode before every localStorage/server write (persists a neutral 'dmView' placeholder instead); setMode now writes only to sessionStorage + in-memory runtimeCache, bypassing the shared persist path entirely.
